meta.outlines: Where OpenStreetMap holds a newer outline than the GURS topographic extract, the OpenStreetMap outline is used and named per building. Heights stay from the GURS survey.
meta.cadastre: kn holds the GURS Kataster nepremičnin record of the building that contains the stored point, read through the OGC API Features service on 12 November 2026. The rules on cadastre data (Pravilnik o vodenju podatkov katastra nepremičnin, articles 13 and 15) define the lowest height as the floor of the first storey, the highest height as the top of the roof or wall, the characteristic height as the terrain at the main entrance, and the number of storeys as all storeys below and above ground. The fields VISINA_H1, H2 and H3 are read as these three heights in that order. Licence CC BY 4.0.
meta.sites: For ZAG facilities the buildings and the site parcels are those where the GURS cadastre lists Zavod za gradbeništvo Slovenije (registration number 5866324000) as manager. Collections DST_UPRAVLJAVCI and PARCELE_UPRAVLJAVCI of the OGC API Features service, read 12 November 2026.
meta.laser_scan: Laser scanning of Slovenia by GURS (CLSS), file series NDMP, one file per square kilometre with 0.5 m pixels, read 2026-11-12. The values are read as height above the ground in metres. This reading rests on the agreement with the cadastre heights, since no official description of the series was found. For every building the pixels whose centre lies inside the outline were taken. The statistics give the number of pixels, the middle value, the levels that 90 % and 99 % of the pixels stay below, and the highest pixel, and the lowest pixel and the mean are stored as well. GURS states that the scanning ran from 2023 to the end of 2025 (gov.si, 27 March 2025). The date of the single sheet is not stored, so a difference from the cadastre can also come from a different year. Data of Geodetska uprava Republike Slovenije, used under its general terms for geodetic data.
meta.areas: Footprint areas of cadastre and OpenStreetMap outlines are computed on the ground from the outline coordinates through the D96/TM projection. Until 12 November 2026 a simpler formula gave values about 0.7 % lower.

cestel.parts_note: Two buildings in Trzin that stand on parcels the GURS cadastre lists under CESTEL cestni inženiring d.o.o. as owner. Building 1365 (Špruha 36, a dwelling of 300 m² and a business part of 1,000 m²) is held with a share of 1/1. Building 1362 (Špruha 32, the registered address of the company, a dwelling of 122 m² and a business part of 255.9 m²) is held with a share of 1/4, the rest by a holder that is not public. Read again on 12 November 2026. Which of the two the company uses was not checked on site.
